value.rationale: Determines the exact integral homotopy and full dihedral H1 character of a natural infinite pure graph-complex family of unbounded dimension; identifies a concrete free-face collapse of its facet nerve, an infinite obstruction to shellability/Cohen--Macaulayness, and a sharp qualitative change in the inclusion into ordinary matching complexes. The result is a structural family classification, not a parameter-only restatement of the known abstract circular-arc theorem.
